identity: VU Dutch full-time Psychology BSc, CROHO 56604, annual basis 2026–2027.
curriculum: The Dutch OER adopted 28 May 2026 and the 2026–2027 Dutch guide agree on 60 plus 48 compulsory EC, 12 connected preminor EC, a 30 EC open semester and a 30 EC final pathway. Select Behaviour and the Brain and Cognition and Emotion by regulation order. The broad prevention pathway follows the prospectus framing, independent of UCR fit. Its required 24 EC includes the 12 EC thesis. The selected track’s third-year taught work is in English; open study is independent.
progression: OER Article 9.1 requires all first-year components for the thesis, and research participation precedes recording Psychological Conversation Skills 1. Article 10.4 applies the Dutch diagnostic and remediation before the Introduction to Psychology grade. The English test in the shared guide grouping adds no obligation. Articles 11–12 regulate practical attendance, pathways and elective approval. Article 14 sets 42 EC for positive first-year advice. The exact Methods 2, Statistics 2, Measurement 2 and Low Intensity Treatments entries verify empirical team research, regression and ANOVA, psychometric validity and bias, and practiced psychological interventions respectively.
